{{quote|A </em>sorda<em> was a kind of rat, especially sly according to the Aiel, and good for absolutely nothing; its flesh was so rank that even cats seldom ate the ones they killed.|[[Rand al'Thor]]'s thoughts on ''sorda''{{ref/book|5|4}}}}
A '''''sorda''''' is a specific type of rat found in the [[Aiel Waste]].  It is also used as an insult by the Aiel.
